claims.reason: `serrin_sq_eLpNorm_le` (private, lines 34-51) and `lps_sq_eLpNorm_le` (public, UniformRelativeBound lines 371-389) have the same hypotheses and conclusion. Their proofs are the same chain: the `eLpNorm_eq_integral_rpow_norm` rewrite, `Real.sqrt_eq_rpow`, `Real.sq_sqrt`, `Real.rpow_two`, then `integral_mono`. Both are called the same way, with the sum-of-squares majorants `hsqD` and `hsqW`. UniformRelativeBound imports this file, so making the Serrin version public and deleting the LPS copy adds no cycle. The argument is about 15 lines of real work (an rpow/sqrt conversion of the L² norm), so it is not a trivial wrapper.

claims.reason: `serrin_triple_pointwise` and `lps_triple_pointwise_euclidean` (the latter is used at UniformRelativeBound line 680 and RelativeBoundEndpoint line 148) have the same proof.
